freeze_and_append_boundaries.absolute_relative_nested_refs: authorization_references recursively recognizes path/SHA and *_path pairs, directory/seal pairs and file-to-SHA maps. Every original and snapshot is added to freeze.files and checked by the actual runner inventory.
freeze_and_append_boundaries.scope_of_recursion: Nested values in READY itself; not arbitrary recursive contents of every referenced JSON. Referenced seals retain their separate dependency semantics.
freeze_and_append_boundaries.ready_race_guard: Freeze captures READY bytes, checks them after release/CPU binding and before final freeze, copies those exact bytes; changed READY is rejected.
freeze_and_append_boundaries.live_logs: Direct SHA-bound references to live budget/attempts.jsonl or scene_registry/entries.jsonl are rejected. Future READY must use the provided sealed budget snapshot.
freeze_and_append_boundaries.scene_prefix: 700 existing records/471628 bytes are sealed; live registry is verified only against that unchanged prefix and may legitimately append. Original authorized prefix binding is preserved when snapshot is copied into the new protocol.
freeze_and_append_boundaries.actual_scenes: Registration alone does not establish20 unique real scenes per task. The original pre-action scene fingerprint/registry check must establish them during capture.
